segments.text:
HAB. 3. 17.
Although the figge tree shall not blossome, neither shall fruit be in the Vines, the labour of the Olive shall faile, and the fields shall yeeld no meat, &c. yet I will rejoyce in the Lord, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

PSAL. 91. 1. 2.
Hee that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high, shall lodge under the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge, and my fortresse; My God in him will I trust.

PSAL. 73. 26.
My strength and my heart faileth, but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
